company.name: Retool
company.shortDescription: Retool is a software development company that offers solutions in AI apps, documentation, developer tools, and external apps.
company.description: Retool is a provider of a tool development platform intended to help build custom business tools without having any programming language knowledge. Its platform creates interfaces to display and manipulate data faster and more accurately with custom workflows, enabling businesses to focus on their product and expertise while giving their operation development teams the tools they need to succeed.
